CHAPTER.VERS:
Alex. the sabbath-day
- The Lord reigns; he has clothed himself with honour: the Lord has clothed and girded himself with strength; for he has established the world, which shall not be moved.
Thy throne is prepared of old: thou art from everlasting.

The rivers have lifted up, O Lord, the rivers have lifted up their voices,
Alex. +the floods will lift up their waves; See Heb.

at
q. d. in answer to the voices of many waters: the billows of the sea are wonderful: the Lord is wonderful in high places.

Thy testimonies are made very sure: holiness becomes thine house, O Lord,
Gr. to length of days for ever.
